label: Ideal resistor
description: Resistance follows Value. Optional temperature coefficients are available as symbol fields.

label: Ideal capacitor
description: Capacitance follows Value and uses the initial voltage field.

label: Ideal inductor
description: Linear inductance follows Value.

label: Basic potentiometer
description: Two resistors in series, with resistance and position controlled by the Value and Wiper fields.

label: Generic NPN transistor
description: Generic NPN model for circuit experiments.
prologue: ?(empty(Model File),.model TC_NPN NPN(Is=1e-14 Bf=200 Vaf=100 Cje=10p Cjc=5p Tf=500p),.include "$(Model File)")

label: Generic PNP transistor
description: Generic PNP model for circuit experiments.
prologue: ?(empty(Model File),.model TC_PNP PNP(Is=1e-14 Bf=100 Vaf=100 Cje=10p Cjc=5p Tf=500p),.include "$(Model File)")

label: Basic N-channel MOSFET
description: Level-one N-channel MOSFET with body tied to source.
prologue: ?(empty(Model File),.model TC_NMOS NMOS(Level=1 Vto=1.5 Kp=20u Lambda=0.02 Gamma=0.5 Phi=0.7),.include "$(Model File)")

label: Basic P-channel MOSFET
description: Level-one P-channel MOSFET with body tied to source.
prologue: ?(empty(Model File),.model TC_PMOS PMOS(Level=1 Vto=-1.5 Kp=10u Lambda=0.02 Gamma=0.5 Phi=0.7),.include "$(Model File)")

label: Generic diode
description: Generic silicon diode with junction capacitance and breakdown.
prologue: ?(empty(Model File),.model TC_D D(Is=1n N=1.8 Rs=0.5 Cjo=2p Tt=4n Bv=100 Ibv=10u),.include "$(Model File)")

label: Basic 5.1 V zener
description: Generic 5.1 V zener diode.
prologue: ?(empty(Model File),.model TC_ZENER5V1 D(Is=1n N=1.6 Rs=2 Bv=5.1 Ibv=1m Cjo=80p),.include "$(Model File)")

label: Basic red LED
description: Electrical approximation of a red indicator LED.
prologue: ?(empty(Model File),.model TC_LED_RED D(Is=1e-18 N=2 Rs=8 Eg=1.8 Cjo=10p),.include "$(Model File)")

label: Basic green LED
description: Electrical approximation of a green indicator LED.
prologue: ?(empty(Model File),.model TC_LED_GREEN D(Is=1e-21 N=2 Rs=10 Eg=2.2 Cjo=10p),.include "$(Model File)")

label: Basic blue LED
description: Electrical approximation of a blue indicator LED.
prologue: ?(empty(Model File),.model TC_LED_BLUE D(Is=1e-26 N=2 Rs=12 Eg=2.8 Cjo=10p),.include "$(Model File)")

label: Basic yellow LED
description: Electrical approximation of a yellow indicator LED.
prologue: ?(empty(Model File),.model TC_LED_YELLOW D(Is=1e-20 N=2 Rs=10 Eg=2 Cjo=10p),.include "$(Model File)")

label: Basic 741 op-amp
description: Behavioural 741 with slew rate, finite gain and output voltage limits.
prologue:
.subckt TC_UA741 P N VP VN OUT
Rin P N 2Meg
Bdrive 0 pole I=max(-15.9154943m,min(15.9154943m,0.2*(v(P)-v(N))))
Rpole pole 0 1Meg
Cpole pole 0 31.8309886n
Blimit drive 0 V=max(v(VN)+2,min(v(VP)-2,v(pole)))
Rout drive OUT 75
.ends TC_UA741

label: Basic transformer
description: Linear transformer with editable winding inductances and coupling.
instance:
LT$(refnum)P %(1) %(2) $(Primary inductance)
LT$(refnum)S %(3) %(4) $(Secondary inductance)
KT$(refnum) LT$(refnum)P LT$(refnum)S $(Coupling)

label: Basic quartz crystal
description: Quartz crystal with editable resonance, motional resistance and capacitance.
instance: X$(ref) %(1) %(2) TC_XTAL PARAMS: FREQ=$(Frequency) RM=$(Motional resistance) CM=$(Motional capacitance) C0=$(Shunt capacitance)

label: Basic ceramic resonator
description: Ceramic resonator with editable resonance and motional circuit.
instance: X$(ref) %(1) %(2) TC_CERAMIC PARAMS: FREQ=$(Frequency) RM=$(Motional resistance) CM=$(Motional capacitance) C0=$(Shunt capacitance)

label: Ideal DC / AC voltage source
description: Ideal voltage source with DC value and optional AC magnitude and phase.
instance: V$(refnum) %(1) %(2) DC $(Value)?(not_empty(AC magnitude), AC $(AC magnitude) $(AC Phase),)

label: Ideal DC / AC current source
description: Ideal current source with DC value and optional AC magnitude and phase.
instance: I$(refnum) %(1) %(2) DC $(Value)?(not_empty(AC magnitude), AC $(AC magnitude) $(AC Phase),)
